summary: Verified Open Graph / Twitter social preview metadata fix for maisoncandice.com static site. All required OG and Twitter meta tags are present in /app/index.html <head>. The og-image.jpg asset is publicly accessible (HTTP 200, image/jpeg) on the preview host with correct 1200x630 dimensions and ~47KB size. Homepage renders visually with no regression.

verification_details.homepage_regression: No regression — page loads, layout intact, hero title/nav/CTA buttons render correctly (verified via screenshot).

critical_code_review_comments: og:url and og:image reference production domain https://maisoncandice.com/ (expected/intentional per request); Facebook debugger scrapes must be run against production domain to force cache refresh — recommend running https://developers.facebook.com/tools/debug/ with the production URL after deploy to prime Messenger cache.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Static site served by /app/frontend/server.js from /app on port 3000. OG metadata fix complete and verified. If Messenger still shows spinner post-deploy on production, this is a Facebook cache issue — solution is to use FB Sharing Debugger to force re-scrape of maisoncandice.com.
